quest.title: For Fontaine!
quest.description: Go to the Opera Epiclese, place your tea table, and have Sandrone take a seat. Then, prepare to enjoy some tea with Furina...

talks.objective: Head for the vicinity of the fountain in front of Opera Epiclese to begin the tea party

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: I feel simply awful leaving all the work to you again, Miss Guillotin.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: It's no trouble. This is the least I can do after your recent support during the Fontinalia Film Festival.

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: Oh, please! The actors were the true stars of the show.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Don't you plan to return to performing yourself, Miss Furina?

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: Well... Never say never... But, uh... right now, I prefer working behind the scenes.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Truth be told, when I still lived in Fontaine, even I knew who you were — the universally beloved superstar, Furina.

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: Ugh, please don't! Whatever you do, don't say you "grew up watching my performances"... It makes me feel so awkward...

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Oh, you've no need to worry there. I just wanted to say that when I left Fontaine, I had the honor of seeing you as you were back then.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: But seeing you again after all this time, I think I prefer the way you carry yourself now.

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: Huh...? The way I carry myself now?

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Yes. You used to look so tense on stage, but these days you seem a lot more relaxed.

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: Hehe... Thank you for saying so. I actually am enjoying life a lot more these days.

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: And what about you, Miss Guillotin? Are you content with your current lifestyle? Compared to when you departed Fontaine, I mean.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Everything's going well, though I suppose that's mostly down to realigning my state of mind. In truth, I've always liked Fontaine, and it's always felt like home.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: I'm not saying it's better than other nations, but it holds so many memories. Life here can be as calm as still water, but it can also be filled with novel changes.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: I've recently learned to see the brighter side of life. I suppose people in other places view their homelands in much the same way.

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: Wow... How beautifully put, Miss Guillotin.

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: This might be a slight breach of tea party etiquette, but... I propose a toast. To Fontaine!

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Haha... To our homeland.

talks.objective: Head for the vicinity of the fountain in front of Opera Epiclese to begin the tea party

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: Ahhh! I'll never get tired of leisurely afternoon teas.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: (Let's sit like this for a little while longer.)

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: My, my... Joyful times truly do pass by in a flash.
